svg.title: stackmon — ccinn's tech stack as a system monitor
svg.desc: btop-style ASCII monitor. Cores (languages): rust, go, c, c++, php, python, js, erlang. Processes (data and infra, PID equals default port): kafka 9092, flink 8081, hadoop 9870, swoole 9501, redis 6379, mysql 3306, postgres 5432, mongodb 27017. dmesg tail (tooling): linux, bash, docker, nginx, git, react, electron, express, next.js, graphql, github actions, erlang.
